# Handoff Analysis

## Summary

The **champion holds** with solid metrics. The system has completed 160 iterations over ~17 hours with ~31 hours remaining.

## Key Metrics Comparison

| Metric | Champion | Last PASS Candidate |
|--------|----------|---------------------|
| Tuning Mean | **1.904** | 1.762 |
| Tuning Min | **0.431** | 0.051 ⚠️ |
| Lockbox Mean | 1.793 | 1.793 |
| Lockbox Min | 1.134 | **1.347** |
| Worst MDD | **-9.3%** | -11.2% |

## Assessment

**Champion strengths:**
- Robust tuning minimum (0.43 vs 0.05) — better fold generalization
- Lower worst-case drawdown (-9.3% vs -11.2%)
- Higher tuning mean

**Candidate note:**
The `exp_macro_alpha_shadow` candidate shows a near-zero tuning minimum (0.05), indicating poor performance on at least one cross-validation fold. This fragility disqualifies it from promotion despite slightly better lockbox consistency.

## Recommended Action

✅ **Let the runloop continue** — System is healthy with 31h remaining budget.

The queued commands are appropriate:
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

No manual intervention needed unless lockbox minimum degrades below 1.0 or worst MDD exceeds -15%.
